title: gr.load() failing with Error
body:
### Describe the bug

I am trying load a pvt space from a public space.
below is code for public space:
demo = gr.load(name="spaces/reporter/TestChatIntf", hf_token = MY_HF_TOKEN_KEY)
demo.launch()

-----------------------
pvt space reporter/TestChatIntf has just following simple code:
import gradio as gr

def echo(message, history):
    return message

demo = gr.ChatInterface(fn=echo, examples=["hello", "hola", "merhaba"], title="Echo Bot")
demo.launch()


Getting below error:
Fetching Space from: https://huggingface.co/spaces/reporter/TestChatIntf
Loaded as API: https://reporter-testchatintf.hf.space ✔
/home/<user>/app/app.py:9: GradioUnusedKwargWarning: You have unused kwarg parameters in Chatbot, please remove them: {'likeable': False}

comments.author: participant3
comments.body:
I am having the same issue. 

.load works fine when I make my source space a public space, but when I change it to a private space I get an error. 

Interestingly, the space is successfully fetched and loaded, however when you interface with it, it usually has a thing, tries to send back an output and then simply produces an error message in the place of the output. 

Like I said, it works fine when the source space is made public. 
Both of my spaces are running Gradio 4.1.1

Temporary solution: I rolled back my gradio SDK version in HF Spaces to use 3.45.0

comments.author: participant4
comments.body:
> But doing this means the PDF of the public space is used rather than the private space

No, that's not the case. All the events will be sent to the upstream/private space. But in order to load the private space in the public space, the custom components used in the private space need to be imported in the public space.
